from urllib.request import urlopen
base='https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/airdata/'

    good_days=(m['1st Max Value']<=4.4).sum(); total=len(m)
    print(a,'days',total,'good_days',good_days,'bad_days',total-good_days)

import pandas as pd, zipfile, io, sys
from urllib.request import urlopen
base='https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/airdata/'
areas=['Portland-Vancouver-Hillsboro, OR-WA','Wichita, KS','San Diego-Carlsbad, CA']
for y in range(2000,2011):
    zdata=urlopen(base+f'daily_42101_{y}.zip').read(); z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(zdata))
    name=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.csv')][0]
    df=pd.read_csv(z.open(name),usecols=['CBSA Name','Date Local','1st Max Value','Units of Measure'])
    df=df[(df['Units of Measure']=='Parts per million') & (df['CBSA Name'].isin(areas))]
    df['Date Local']=pd.to_datetime(df['Date Local'])
    mx=df.groupby(['CBSA Name','Date Local'],sort=False)['1st Max Value'].max()
    ok=True
    for a in areas:
        s=mx.loc[a]
        if len(s)!= (366 if (y%4==0 and (y%100!=0 or y%400==0)) else 365):
            ok=False; break
        if (s>4.4).any():
            ok=False; break
    if ok:
        print(y)
